After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.

Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage.

Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed.
Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.

Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage, Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits.

Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which you float slowly and cannot perform actions. Afterwards you gain Spirit Power, Move Speed, and Spirit Resist.
Can be canceled early.
Activation cancels any active ability.

Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming, and preventing item usage. Removes all non-ultimate buffs.

Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.
Imbue an ability to increase its Duration.
Increases the duration of your abilities and items.
Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

description.active: Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration.
Grants Lifesteal, Fire Rate, and Ammo. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

description.desc:
Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount.

This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist.

Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.
Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks.

If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.
Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.
Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.
Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.
Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.
When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.
Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.

Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.
Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.
Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit an enemy hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.
Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.
Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.
Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

Make your weapon fire multishot.

Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus.

Targets can only be hit once per multishot.
While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.

Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet.
Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.
Block the next spirit damage or Debuff, preventing its effects. Only regenerates outside of combat.
After dealing an accumulated 200 spirit damage, your next Heavy Melee Attack deals an additional 200 spirit damage.
When you receive a Boon, automatically heal.

Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.
The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.
Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.
Kills or assists cause an explosion where the victim dies. Kills against heroes have greater radius and damage.
Taking heavy hits of spirit damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown.

Applying heal to yourself or an ally grants the target bonus fire rate and bonus move speed.

Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals.
Gain infinite ammo and bonus fire rate.
Each hero kill grants permanent Weapon Damage (up to a max of 0 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.
Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.
You have infinite ammo.
Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.
The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.

While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed.
Each stack refreshes the duration.

Dealing weapon damage at close range opens a wound and grants you bonus move speed.

Wounded enemies take spirit damage over time, have reduced bullet resist, and are revealed through walls.
Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.
When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.
After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.
Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.
Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.
Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff.
Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies.

Your next bullet applies a powerful debuff reducing the enemy's damage output, healing and movement speed. It also deals bonus spirit damage based on the targets current Health.

The bullet is larger and penetrates through targets.
Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus move speed
Everytime you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.

When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you.

Cooldown is per target.
You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.

Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power. When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage.

Cooldown is per target.
Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.
Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.
Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities.
Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive.
description.active:
Hatch the egg, gaining souls and permanent buffs.

The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it.

Gain a permanent buff per 80 Souls accrued when hatched.

description.desc: Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing weapon damage and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive stun and take bonus weapon damage.
description.t2_desc: -10s Ability Cooldown and +0.4s Stun Duration
description.t3_desc: On Wall Stun: Your next heavy melee is blessed

description.desc:
Burn your censer, reducing incoming damage and healing over time.

You cannot attack while Potent Vapors is active.
Taking damage grants stacking bullet resist and spirit resist that expires over time.
Equip your crossbow, changing your weapon to deal pure damage and apply a brief slow.
description.t3_desc: On-Hit: Execute enemies below 30%

description.desc:
Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased weapon damage.

The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.
description.t1_desc: While Active: Gain 1.2 m/s Move Speed
description.t2_desc: -15s Ability Cooldown and +65 Bonus Damage
description.t3_desc: All Stakes are Blessed

description.desc: Throw a tear gas grenade that detonates after a delay, blocking vision. Enemies in the area have reduced fire rate.
description.t2_desc: On Debuff: Drain -1 Stamina per Second

description.desc: Gain passive barrier that grants bullet resist and spirit resist. The barrier repairs itself when out of combat.
description.t3_desc: On Barrier Break: Gain 35% Weapon Damage for 6s

description.desc: Throw a censer that leaves a spreading cloud. Enemies caught in the cloud are Slowed and Silenced.
description.t3_desc: On Debuff: Silences Stamina Usage

description.desc:
Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing weapon damage and setting enemies on fire.

Burning targets deal pure damage to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing.
description.t2_desc: +1.5m Radius & +1.0s Burn Duration
description.t3_desc: -20% Healing Reduction and allow Charges

description.desc:
Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay.

The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing spirit damage, applying immobilize, and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.
description.t3_desc:
+1 Charge
Deal +30% damage against revealed targets

description.desc:
Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback.

Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.
description.t2_desc: +2m Radius and applies -35% Fire Rate
description.t3_desc: +100 Damage and +1 Charge

description.desc:
Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities.

When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage.
description.t1_desc: -1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
description.t2_desc: +3m Radius and +0.75s Sleep Duration
description.t3_desc:
-55s cooldown
Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling

description.desc:
Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers.

Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed.

Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team.

Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.
description.t1_desc:
+1 Helper
+1.5m/s Move Speed
description.t2_desc:
+1 Helper
+15% Trooper Damage and Resist
description.t3_desc:
+1 Helper
+15% Spirit Resist

description.desc:
Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration.

Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally.

You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability.
You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.
description.t2_desc: 35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
description.t3_desc:
+15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after napping
Improved Spirit Scaling

description.desc: Hop to another ally and refresh the regeneration duration, once per ally.
Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.
description.t1_desc: Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
description.t2_desc: On Player Hit: +1 stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit
description.t3_desc: Can be Recast within 4s

description.desc:
Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist.

Press Ability 2 to select a target.
Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
description.t2_desc: -25% Melee Resist and +0.4s Stun Duration
description.t3_desc: Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s

description.desc:
Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage.

Press Ability 3 to re-cast.
description.t1_desc: Perfect Hit on Hero: Heal 35
description.t2_desc: -12s Cooldown. Gain +60% Bullet Resist during lunge
description.t3_desc:
+65 Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling.
Increased lunge speed & distance.

description.desc:
Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies.

While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage.

Hold Ability 4 or to delay the cast.

Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize.

Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.
description.t2_desc: +90 Damage and +10m Wall Length
description.t3_desc:
+1 Ghouls Raised
-14s Cooldown
+0.75s Immobilize Duration

description.desc:
Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead.

Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies.

Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.
description.t1_desc: Collecting death heals 5 health per pickup
description.t2_desc: On Hit: Apply 24% Slow for 1s
description.t3_desc:
+2 Deadheads
+4s Deadhead Lifetime

description.t1_desc:
+25% Ghoul Speed
-15s Cooldown
description.t2_desc:
+10s Duration
-0.3s Time To Spawn
description.t3_desc: On Death: Deal +5% Current Health as Damage

description.desc:
Kill a Ghoul or low-health ally, gaining their lifeforce.

: Throw the lifeforce as a bomb, dealing spirit damage.
: Consume the lifeforce, receiving healing.

Gain a barrier and bonus move speed.

When the barrier expires you release a ring of necrotic energy, dealing spirit damage and applying slow.
Your weapon steals weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.
description.t3_desc:
+1 Max Steal Targets
All Summons now apply Essence Theft

description.desc:
Grant an ally bonus move speed and spectres which orbit around them.

The spectres will seek nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage and applying slow.

description.t3_desc: Summon a Deadhead every 10 stacks

description.desc:
Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy.

Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.
description.t3_desc: If you hit all shots, deal +7% current health as damage

description.t2_desc: On Hero Hit: Restore 2 Stamina
description.t3_desc: +80 Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s

description.desc: Leap forward, mauling the first enemy hit for melee damage. They suffer from reduced bullet resist and take spirit damage over time.
Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage, applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.
description.t3_desc:
+0.75s Debuff Duration.
Bola ricochets to 2 additional targets

description.desc: Smash enemies around you, dealing spirit damage. They suffer from disarm and a brief slow.
description.t3_desc: +1.5s Debuff Duration

description.desc:
Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse.

Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health, and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.
description.t1_desc: +15% Bullet & Spirit Resistance
description.t2_desc: +4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
description.t3_desc: On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration

description.desc:
Human:Track the last hero you hit. Killing tracked enemies grants bonus souls.

Werewolf:Track any low-health heroes nearby. Killing tracked heroes reduce your cooldowns.
Gain bonus fire rate and bonus move speed, half to nearby allies. Kills during this time recasts On The Hunt.
Return back to your human form.
Deal melee damage to all enemies in front of you, receiving a heal for a portion of the damage dealt. The damage is increased the lower health they have.
Leap through the air before landing, dealing melee damage and applying slow to nearby enemies while pushing them away.
description.t1_desc: On Landing: +2 m/s Move Speed for 5s
description.t3_desc: Applies 1.2s Stun

description.desc: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.
description.t2_desc: -10s Cooldown and +3m Cast Range
description.t3_desc: +22 Damage and Increased Spirit Scaling

description.desc: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
description.t2_desc: +70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
description.t3_desc: +1.25 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.

description.desc:
Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.

Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
description.t1_desc: -16% Move Speed and -14% Dash Distance
description.t2_desc: +90 Damage and Increased Spirit Scaling
description.t3_desc: +6 Max Bounces and -30s Cooldown

description.desc:
Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area.

Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.
